youtube.title: Samundar ka paani namkeen kyun hota hai? 🌊 #Shorts
youtube.description:
Nadiyon ka paani namkeen nahi hota, phir samundar ka paani kyun? Baarish thodi si acidic hoti hai aur dheere-dheere chattanon ko ghula deti hai. Nadiyan un chhote ghule hue minerals ko samundar tak le jaati hain.

Suraj paani ko bhaap bana deta hai, lekin namak peeche reh jaata hai. Samundar ki tali par bane hot vents aur namak jodte hain. Agar saara namak nikaal kar zameen par bichha diya jaaye, to wo lagbhag ek sau pachaas meter gehra hoga.

The Hidden Why ka Hindi edition: roz ki cheezon ke peeche ki asli wajah.
